items.title: Sid Davilla Interview, 1969-04-17
items.q: What we did was Smiling Joe up there, and Joe Robichaud and Lizzie Miles and Blanche Thomas did up there.

ctx.x: About ten years. Well, that, they've got this, you know, this very large stuff, like they have, is it that way or that way? That way. That way. That way, puppies, yes. That's the latest, uh, thing that everybody thinks today.

Well, it's on its way out now. I understand the biggest discotheque in, uh, New York called Arthur. They're for sale. And these things are dying on the street. There aren't too many of them left anyway, thank God, because with that, uh, amplification was too much. Too much. I mean, they weren't content with you hearing the music. They had to, you know, just actually beat your eardrums in with it. I don't know how they stand it. But it's on its way out. Now the thing seems to be too a little, uh, the folk has gone…
He used to play the guitar.
